text:
My hands
+
+open the curtains of your being
+
+dress you in another nakedness
+
+uncover the bodies of your body
+
+My hands
+
+invent another body for your body.

translation.title: My Hands…
translation.editorial_note: The erotic paradox of dressing the beloved in nakedness is preserved, as is the repeated body through which touch discovers and invents.
